message.content:
This looks like a CBP ruling on range hood covers (wood). The likely classification is 4421.99 (other articles of wood) or 4418 (builders' joinery and carpentry), though the products are not functional range hoods, so 8414.90 is out. Non-functional covers that merely obscure the hood are made of wood, MDF, and particle board, and may be classified as other articles of wood.

CBP rulings on "wood range hood covers" are probably 4421.99.9780 (other articles of wood, other). Because the covers are made of MDF and particleboard, one possibility is 4421.99.9880 (the statistical suffix for other wood articles, formerly 4421.99.97). Another is 4418.79 or 4418.99 (builders' joinery). The covers are custom made and fixed to the ceiling, but they are not kitchen cabinets and serve a decorative, enclosing function, so they are more like decorative woodwork than joinery. I settle on 4421.99.9880.

The current HTS has 4421.99.97 (other) with a statistical suffix of 4421.99.9780, and also 4421.99.9880 for "other" under 4421.99.98. In recent years, 4421.99.97 covers "Other: Other: Other", so I will use 4421.99.9780.

{"hts_code": "4421.99.9780", "reason": "Non-functional wood/MDF/particleboard range hood covers that only conceal a hood are not cabinets, joinery, or hood parts, so they fall under other articles of wood in heading 4421."}
